Hi Jordan — thanks for the details and the screenshot.

Short answer: this looks like a partial/legacy registration that created a \"shadow\" vendor account tied to a different identifier (likely a different email alias or an earlier invite). Our vendor onboarding system prevents duplicate profiles so the claim link is blocked.

Next steps I can run from my side:
- Ask Vendor Ops to merge the legacy profile into the new Lumena record and then re-issue a fresh claim link bound to the correct email.
- If merging requires proof of identity/tax docs we can accept the signed W-9 — I'll attach the template below so you can sign and return.
- If you'd prefer, we can do a 20-minute screen share while I walk the ops team through the merge and confirm you can log in.

I've looped in Ben (Vendor Ops lead) and Marissa (Contracts) so they can take the merge + legal checklist.

Attachments: W-9_template.pdf (fillable), quick screenshot of the error you've sent.

Thanks,
